items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Is Grading AI Debt As Risk Questions Follow
items.summary: S&P Global (NYSE:SPGI) is taking a central role in rating a growing wave of AI linked debt instruments that are attracting institutional demand. S&P Global Ratings has assigned relatively high grades to structures backed by AI related projects that are drawing capital from insurance companies. Analysts have raised concerns that complex repayment terms and concentrated exposures within these AI themed securities could magnify credit risk. items.title: Celsius Holdings outlook lifted to positive by S&P as leverage falls to 1.7x
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings revised its outlook on Celsius Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:CELH) to positive from stable on Monday, signaling potential for a credit upgrade as the energy drink maker’s expanded brand portfolio offsets near-term softness in its flagship label. The rating agency affirmed Celsius’ ‘BB-’ issuer credit rating alongside its ‘BB+’ issue-level rating on the company's existing revolver and term loan, citing strong operating momentum and reduced debt leverage.
